name: MoneyMentor
summary: A financial planning platform for the modern Indian investor that combines rule-based financial logic with Gemini AI to provide insights into portfolio health, retirement goals, and joint/couple finances. Deterministic financial math (XIRR, FIRE projections, tax optimization) is computed in Python/NumPy, with Gemini layered on top for narrative insight rather than doing the calculations itself.

agenticRoles.name: X-Ray Analyst
agenticRoles.description: Parses mutual fund statements (CAMS/KFintech PDFs) and calculates performance metrics (XIRR, asset allocation, fund overlap).

agenticRoles.name: Health Advisor
agenticRoles.description: Rules-based engine scoring financial habits across 6 dimensions, augmented by Gemini for contextual insight.

agenticRoles.name: FIRE Strategist
agenticRoles.description: Long-term projection specialist for early retirement planning (corpus and SIP requirements).

agenticRoles.name: Couple Optimizer
agenticRoles.description: Tax and joint-finance expert for household optimization (HRA, NPS, 80C).

errorHandling: Graceful handling of malformed PDF statements during parsing
Mock data fallbacks for all endpoints on API failure
Strict Pydantic models validating every entry point

keyFeatures: Portfolio X-Ray: CAMS/KFintech PDF upload for instant XIRR, asset allocation, and fund overlap analysis
Financial Health Score across 6 dimensions (Emergency Fund, Debt, Insurance, Diversification, Savings, Retirement)
FIRE Calculator: projected corpus and SIP requirements for early retirement
Goal Planner: tracks multiple life goals and detects funding conflicts
Life Events: analyzes financial impact of major life events (marriage, kids, job change)
Couple Finance: tax optimization (HRA, NPS, 80C) and joint investment planning

challenges.title: Keeping AI advisory and financial math separate
challenges.description: Designed the system so all numeric outputs (XIRR, tax, projections) are deterministic Python calculations, with Gemini used only to explain/contextualize results, not to compute them.

challenges.title: Real-world PDF parsing
challenges.description: CAMS/KFintech statement formats vary across fund houses, requiring resilient parsing with graceful fallback on malformed input.
